name: Aurora Chime Atoll
core_rationale: Eastern resonant starlight-bell archipelago of Continent 03 where Vesper's suspended crystal stalactites ring in harmony with the solar-wind aurora.
local_conflict: Harmonic aurora-seraphs and starlight bell-motley spirits guard the suspended resonance bridges.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Star-navigators say that when the aurora curtains brush Aurora Chime Atoll, the suspended crystal stalactites ring out across forty miles of open sky.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A floating ring of basalt arches hung with luminous crystal stalactite bells beneath shimmering violet-green aurora ribbons.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What celestial bell-foundry floats at the center of Aurora Chime Atoll?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the eastern aurora rim of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt arches hung with luminous crystal stalactite bells chiming in the solar-wind aurora.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: bell-pier walkway and crystal stair metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the ninth District frontier on Continent 03 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
